review.body:
Tommies came in with a league-average attack and a 9% leakier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 21 and 21 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.6, they scored 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under); projected to allow 3.6, they allowed 2 (−1.6 goals, 45% under).

Badgers came in with a 9% above average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 21 and 21 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.6, they scored 2 (−1.6 goals, 45% under); projected to allow 2.6, they allowed 1 (−1.6 goals, 61% under).

The bigger miss was Badgers' scoring (-1.6 goals against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.
